FieldSource.description: Where a product's name, brand, size, category or tags came from (ADR-0018).
FieldSource.title: FieldSource

LineKind.description:
What a receipt line is. Only DISCOUNT lines, and a DEPOSIT returned, carry negative
totals.
LineKind.title: LineKind

MatchSource.description: How a line was linked to its product, in matching order (PLAN 6).
MatchSource.title: MatchSource

ProcessingStage.description: Where a receipt is in the pipeline; reported live from Stage 2 (SSE).
ProcessingStage.title: ProcessingStage

ProductOut.description:
``field_sources`` maps each stamped field (``canonical_name``, ``brand``, ``size``,
``category``, ``tags``) to where it came from; ``llm`` is a guess to show as suggested.
``confirmed``: a person or a product database named it.
ProductOut.title: ProductOut

ProductSummaryOut.description:
A product as listed: ``times_bought`` counts its receipt lines, ``last_purchase`` is the
newest of them.
ProductSummaryOut.title: ProductSummaryOut

ProductUpdateIn.description:
The fields a person changed; a missing or null field is left as it is. ``size`` is text
like ``500 g``; an empty ``brand`` or ``size``, or no ``tags``, clears the field.
ProductUpdateIn.title: ProductUpdateIn

ResolveReviewIn.description:
Either ``accept`` (the extraction as read) or a corrected ``draft``. One that does not
add up is refused unless ``force`` is set with a ``reason``.
ResolveReviewIn.title: ResolveReviewIn

ReviewAnswerOut.description:
The receipt once the answer is queued: the worker saves it (poll GET
/api/receipts/{receipt_id}).
ReviewAnswerOut.title: ReviewAnswerOut

ReviewDraftBody.description:
A reading of the receipt, as the review shows it and as a person corrects it: amounts in
cents of ``currency``, lines in printed order.
ReviewDraftBody.title: ReviewDraftBody

ReviewIssueOut.description: Why the receipt waits for a person; ``position`` is the draft line it is about.
ReviewIssueOut.title: ReviewIssueOut

ReviewLineBody.description:
One line of a reading. ``applies_to`` is the index, in ``lines``, of the item a discount
belongs to.
ReviewLineBody.title: ReviewLineBody

ReviewOut.description:
One review: ``draft`` is the extraction to accept or correct (null when there is none
and the reading must be typed in); ``image_url`` serves the receipt's photo.
``answer_queued``: an answer is queued or running in the worker (answering again is a
409).
ReviewOut.title: ReviewOut

ReviewSummaryOut.description:
An open review as listed; ``reading`` is the extraction it holds, null when there is
none (the reading never parsed).
ReviewSummaryOut.title: ReviewSummaryOut

get.description: Every product category with its display label, in a stable order.
The process is up. Touches no database or other dependency.
Every component is usable. Answers 503 with the same body when one is not.

503.description: A component is not ready; the body says which and why.

get.description:
Every product with at least one receipt line, by name, each with how often it was
bought and its newest purchase.
One product with its field sources; an unknown id is a 404 problem.

patch.description:
Write the fields sent and stamp each ``person``; the others are kept. A blank name or
an unreadable size is a 422 problem, an unknown id a 404 problem.

post.description:
Accept the product's current values as the person's (every filled field stamped
``person``); an unknown id is a 404 problem.

get.description: Receipts newest first. A bad cursor or limit is a 422 problem.

200.description: The photo was uploaded before: its receipt, not processed again.

get.description: One receipt with its lines and an arithmetic report computed from the current data.

The receipt's stored photo (every photo is stored as a JPEG); a receipt without one, or
an unknown receipt, is a 404 problem.

The open reviews a person can answer now, newest first, whatever their receipt's
status; one whose answer is queued or running is left out.

One review with its issues, the reading it holds and its photo; an unknown id is a 404
problem.

post.description:
Accept the reading as read or save a corrected one; the worker resumes the receipt with
it. A reading that does not add up is a 422 problem of type /problems/inconsistent-receipt
listing each issue in ``errors``, unless ``force`` is set with a ``reason``. An unknown
review is a 404 problem; one already resolved, or already answered, a 409 problem.
